text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I am the Mile King of Spring!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Showing off running like that on such bad track conditions...
Just how much power do they have?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
To think she's this strong...!
Taiki Shuttle really is amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was so exciting!!
Great job, Taiki Shuttleー!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The customers are thrilled!
Are you happy too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I feel on top of the world!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Booyahhhhhh!
Everyone is happy, so I'm happy too♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, with this, we have 1 Sprint GⅠ victory towards our goal!
Which race will be our 2nd win?
To etch Taiki Shuttle's greatest charm—her "speed"—into everyone's hearts next time—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow!? It's a race with
an even shorter range than a mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, I got it!!
I'll go show them what my speed's made of!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Blinking is a non-non, you know!
